mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the quarters when real GDP growth declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the CPI is rising by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek higher returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the federal funds rate is below 1% and CPI increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls decrease by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase by more than 10% month-over-month and real personal consumption expenditures also increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic growth prospects improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when housing starts increase by more than 10% and real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters when industrial production increases by more than 1%.
